tasks.title: Record the resolved random ratio in meta.json
tasks.notes: Strategy.meta()/restore(); random writes meta.json['strategy'] {ratio, ratio_source, cloud_questions, questions} and a resume keeps the recorded ratio (warns if the source changed or the question count differs). Other strategies write no 'strategy' key (test_metrics asserts the exact key set).
